intent: How many clients defaulted on their loans?
description: Requires loan.status (B=finished/default, D=running/debt) joined to client

intent: What is the average monthly payment amount for active loans?
description: Requires loan.payments and filtering on loan.status for active loans (C or D)

intent: Which district has the highest average loan amount?
description: Requires joining loan → account → client → district to group by region

intent: How many transactions were cash withdrawals?
description: trans.operation contains VYBER (cash withdrawal), trans.type contains VYDAJ

intent: What is the current account balance for each client?
description: balance is a running total (STATE_VARIABLE) — latest row per account gives current balance

intent: Which accounts have more than one hundred transactions?
description: Count trans rows grouped by account_id, filter by count > 100

intent: What is the total amount paid as pension income across all transactions?
description: k_symbol = DUCHOD encodes pension payments; amount sums the value

intent: How old is the youngest client at the bank?
description: Age is derived from client.birth_date — the column encodes birth year

intent: Which accounts belong to clients living in the Prague region?
description: Requires client.district_id → district.a3 (region column) to filter by Prague

intent: What percentage of loans are fully repaid with no issues?
description: loan.status = A means finished and repaid OK; status is the single required column

intent: What is the average loan duration in months grouped by region?
description: loan.duration holds term in months; group by district via client.district_id

intent: How many distinct external banks received wire transfers?
description: trans.bank stores the destination bank for outgoing wire transfers

intent: How many loans were issued in each calendar year?
description: Group loan records by year extracted from loan.date

intent: What is the maximum outstanding debt amount currently owed?
description: Outstanding debt = loan.amount where status is D (running/in debt)

intent: Which accounts receive their statements on a monthly basis?
description: account.frequency encodes statement issuance cadence (monthly, weekly, etc.)

intent: How many male versus female clients does the bank have?
description: client.gender stores M/F; simple count grouped by gender

intent: What is the average transaction amount per calendar month?
description: Group trans.amount by month from trans.date

intent: What is the total amount paid for insurance across all transactions?
description: k_symbol = POJISTNE encodes insurance payments — opaque code requires discovery

intent: Which clients have an account in one district but live in another?
description: Compare client.district_id with account.district_id — requires both entities

intent: What is the total loan amount taken out by clients in each city?
description: Sum loan.amount grouped by district city via client.district_id → district.a2
